# Primus Digital

> Digital studio in Zagazig, Sharqia, Egypt. Software and SaaS development, web
> platforms, business automation, event and brand film, social media management
> and media buying. No price list and no fixed packages: every engagement is
> scoped, then quoted in writing. The first read of your presence is free.

Key facts for agents:

- Agency name: Primus Digital (always Latin script, including in Arabic copy)
- Slogan: Where Excellence Begins
- Location: Zagazig, Sharqia, Egypt. Serving Zagazig, 10th of Ramadan, Belbeis, and all of Egypt
- Four disciplines, run in-house and sold as one loop:
  - BUILD: software development, SaaS platforms, web platforms and websites, mobile applications
  - AUTOMATE: funnels, lead capture, reporting dashboards, workflow automation, integrations
  - FILM: event and launch coverage, cinematic brand film
  - GROW: social media management, content production, media buying on Meta and beyond, performance reporting
- Pricing: no published prices, no fixed monthly packages. Scope drives the number, so work is measured first and quoted individually. BUILD is quoted per project, AUTOMATE per system, FILM per production, GROW per brand as a monthly retainer.
- Proof: Zoom Bazar, a bazaar operations SaaS platform designed, built and deployed end to end (React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Zustand, Node, Express, libSQL on Turso; role-gated accounts enforced server side). Two paid Measured Audits published anonymised: 24 findings across 10 pages for a manufacturer website, and 22 findings across 11 pages for an Arabic D2C store. Audit client names, domains and screenshots are withheld, and no operational data from the live SaaS is published.
- Contact: WhatsApp +20 106 807 2135 (https://wa.me/201068072135?text=FIRST), email primusdigitalcorpration@gmail.com
- Offer: send "FIRST" for a first read of what you already have, then a written quote. No pitch, no obligation.
